title: Hemoglobin–RDW interaction did not establish improved cross-cycle depression-screen prediction
abstract: A source-standardized hemoglobin-by-RDW interaction did not establish added cross-cycle prediction of PHQ-9 >=10 beyond flexible component, demographic and biochemical measures: weighted Brier reduction -0.00002185, two-sample preprocessing-and-coefficient-refit PSU-bootstrap 95% interval [-0.00027461, 0.00013724].
